### Research

- Using transcriptome data to evaluate adaptive differences between yellow and pink iguanas from Galapagos.
- Continuing as a research associate at the University of Rome Tor Vergata,
  working on remote monitoring systems for species at risk of extinction.
- Developing the next generation of the [T.A.Co.](taco.qmd) tracking system —
  smaller, cheaper, and able to report physiological as well as positional data.
- Analysing data from the [M.A.C.R.A.](macra.qmd) pilot on recovering cardiac
  and respiratory rates from inertial sensors.

### Writing

- Several manuscripts in review and in preparation — the current state of all
  of them is on the [publications](publications.qmd) page.
- Occasional longer posts on the [blog](blog.qmd), usually about R, data
  wrangling, or something that went wrong in the field.

### Reading & learning

- Keeping up with the quickly moving literature on genomics of small
  populations.
- Improving my Quarto and R workflow — this site is part of that experiment.

### Away from the desk

- Photography, mostly of reptiles and of places that are hard to get to. Some
  of it ends up in the [gallery](photos.qmd).
- Riding my MTB. Helps to keep me fit and it takes away the eyes and the mind from the screen and the people for a while. 

:::
